page-navigation: false

  - id: recent-posts
    contents:
      - posts
    exclude:
      title: ""
    type: default
    image-align: left
    image-height: 64px
    fields: [image, date, title]
    max-items: 4
    page-size: 4
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    date-format: "MMM D, YYYY"
    sort:
      - "date desc"
      - "title asc"
---

```{=html}
<style>
  #title-block-header { display: none; }
  /* break out of Quarto's page column to use (almost) the full window width */
  #home-e { position: relative; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: min(1760px, calc(100vw - 3rem)); font-size: 1.18rem; }
  #home-e .grid { row-gap: 1.25rem; column-gap: 1.75rem; }
  /* hero: big logo + tagline + intro */
  #home-e .hero { text-align: center; padding: 0 1rem .25rem; }
  #home-e .hero img { height: min(210px, 20vh); width: auto; max-width: 100%; }
  #home-e .hero .tagline { font-size: 1.6rem; color: #1b4f72; margin: .4rem 0 .3rem; font-weight: 500; }
  #home-e .hero .lead-text { font-size: 1.05em; color: #444; max-width: 980px; margin: 0 auto; }
  #home-e h2 { border: 0; font-size: 1.6rem; margin: .5rem 0 .5rem; }
  #home-e .what-we-do > h2 { text-align: center; }
  /* "What we do": 4 cards in one row, icon on top */
  #home-e .features { row-gap: .9rem; column-gap: .9rem; }
  #home-e .feature { border: 1px solid #e3ebf1; border-radius: 8px; padding: .6rem 1rem; height: 100%; background: #fff; }
  #home-e .feature p { margin: 0; text-align: center; line-height: 1.35; }
  #home-e .feature i { display: block; font-size: 1.9rem; color: #5a9bbf; margin-bottom: .2rem; }
  #home-e .philosophy { background: #f4f8fb; border-left: 4px solid #1b4f72; padding: .75rem 1.25rem;
    margin: .8rem 0 0; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; }
  #home-e .philosophy h3 { margin: 0 0 .35rem; font-size: 1.3rem; color: #1b4f72; }
  #home-e .philosophy p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.4; }
  /* news band (as in variant C), full height of the row */
  #home-e .news-panel { background: #e8f1f7; border-radius: 8px; padding: .75rem 1.25rem .5rem; margin-top: 1rem; }
  #home-e .news-panel .news-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; }
  /* horizontal band: 4 posts side by side (2 on tablets, 1 on phones) */
  #home-e #listing-recent-posts .list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); column-gap: 1.25rem; }
  @media (max-width: 1199.98px) { #home-e #listing-recent-posts .list { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
  @media (max-width: 575.98px) { #home-e #listing-recent-posts .list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  #home-e .news-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 .4rem; font-size: 1.45rem; color: #1b4f72; }
  #home-e #listing-recent-posts, #home-e #listing-recent-posts .list { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  #home-e .news-panel p:empty, #home-e .news-panel .listing-no-matching { display: none; }
  #home-e #listing-recent-posts .quarto-post { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px 1fr; grid-template-areas: none;
    column-gap: .8rem; row-gap: .1rem; padding: .45rem 0; margin: 0; border-bottom: 0; }
  #home-e #listing-recent-posts .quarto-post:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  #home-e #listing-recent-posts .thumbnail { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / span 2; margin: 0; }
  #home-e #listing-recent-posts .thumbnail img { width: 64px; height: 64px !important; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; }
  #home-e #listing-recent-posts .body { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
  #home-e #listing-recent-posts .metadata { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; display: block; text-align: left; }
  #home-e #listing-recent-posts .listing-title { font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0; font-weight: 500; }
  #home-e #listing-recent-posts .listing-date { font-size: .9rem; color: #5b6b78; }
  #home-e .all-posts { font-size: 1rem; }
  /* Dark mode (light/dark toggle) */
  body.quarto-dark #home-e .hero .tagline,
  body.quarto-dark #home-e .philosophy h3,
  body.quarto-dark #home-e .news-panel h2 { color: #5dade2; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-e .hero .lead-text { color: #ced4da; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-e .feature { background: #2b3035; border-color: #495057; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-e .philosophy { background: #26323c; border-left-color: #5dade2; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-e .news-panel { background: #26323c; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-e #listing-recent-posts .listing-date { color: #adb5bd; }
</style>
```

:::::{.philosophy}
### Lab philosophy

The Lab philosophy is focused on rigour and **Open Science** principles. We are committed to sharing our code, methods, data, results but also teaching materials and educational resources to the scientific community, to promote transparency, reproducibility and collaboration in research.
